g.text: Use 60 × 60 × 4 plates. X lower, Y upper. Stop

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202e38

g.text: relative travel at ±6 mm. Two opposed springs per

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202e38

g.text: axis each supply 0.25 N/mm. Center at zero.

g.text: Peak indicators

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202e38

g.text: One Ø2 guide rod, two friction rings and one

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202e38

g.text: slotted fork per axis. Push each ring against its

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202e38

g.text: fork face at reset. Mark +3 and −3 mm relative to

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202e38

g.text: those faces. If either ring reaches its own red line,

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202e38

g.text: the event persists through unloading and reversal.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #116d73

g.text: What it measures

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202e38

g.text: The indicator records relative planar travel of the

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202e38

g.text: held mug and dorsal wrist. A-to-B motion is common

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202e38

g.text: to both frames. Loads or contacts elsewhere may

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202e38

g.text: leave no displacement. This benchmark makes no

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202e38

g.text: force measurement or injury inference.
